Subject: August 7 Reading Club in Room 2

Hi readers,

Our next reading club gathering takes place on August 7 in Room 2, and we would love to see fresh faces around the table. We keep the evening relaxed and welcoming for first-timers. If you are a newcomer joining us, please bring a poem to share.

Whether you are a longtime regular or curious to listen in, our next gathering is open to everyone. The reading club meets August 7 in Room 2 for an unhurried evening of shared pages and discussion. We warmly invite newcomers to bring a poem that has stayed with them lately.
